policy: Run full raw mix, actual causal P4 NS output (10 ms frames, medium mode, no delay compensation), or released host DeepFilterNet with latency compensation from the start of each input. Frozen C161 alone; record delivered block clock and P4 Opus processed waveform for every detected target. The host DeepFilterNet alignment is an offline upper-bound timing assumption. No joint firmware scheduling, physical acoustic measurements or independent source voices.
